description: Election Commission - Local Authority Election - 2025 Notice under Section 66(2) Elected Members List - Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette contains election results and declarations for local authority elections, including the names of elected members for specific wards and the declaration of election outcomes by the Election Commission under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This fits the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which covers election results, candidate declarations, and electoral commission decisions.
